title: Teaching SPA deck manifest
description: The ordered teaching spine. A segment references curriculum files by path and copies no prose: every string is an id or a workspace-relative POSIX path, so none can hold sentences. Whether the paths exist, and whether minutes equals the slide's front-matter minutes, is AC2 (tests/spa/content-refs.test.ts).

$schema.description: Relative path to the schema this file is validated against. Constrained so it cannot hold a sentence: the description above promises no string in this file carries prose.

id.description: Stable segment id; interactions.json refers to it. Unique within the deck.

labRefs.description: Labs taught in this segment, under labs/.

minutes.description: Time budget in minutes; must equal the minutes front-matter value of slideSource (AC2).
